column1: # mapping_set_title: "ESMO breast cancer CPG data points -> ECCDM element crosswalk"

# comment: "Subjects are data points that ESMO recommendations depend on (a requirement source, not a dataset). Rows exist only for data points with a hub element; the elements.csv hub_carriage column classifies the rest."

column2: subject_label
column13: comment

column2: Age at diagnosis
column13: Derivable from birthDate and the diagnosis date; the hub carries the date, not the age.

column2: Sex
column13: Drives: Tamoxifen rather than AI alone in men; GnRH agonist with CDK4/6i in men

column2: Comorbidities
column13: Hub fixes the time point at cancer diagnosis; the metastatic guideline needs comorbidities at MBC diagnosis, i.e. the same element re-asserted later.

column2: Histological type
column13: ICD-O-3 morphology carries type and behaviour.
